resources.string: Default catalogue order now follows increasing distance from the Sun. Value columns match the selected sort, with selected objects kept first.
Faster satellite-data recovery with validated alternative sources. Loading, outdated data, dates outside coverage and unavailable values have distinct messages.
Daily path opens with Current centered where possible. Returning to an object keeps the position you consulted during the session.
Landscape has a 55/45 sky/information split. GPS altitude is clearer; 0°/90° and Weather swap places while camera controls keep their positions.
Orbit and celestial-guide captions stay closer to their own lines, with steadier placement near crossings and when switching the camera view.
Capture has the same size as the other controls, a gentle pulsing border and a finer symbol. Control spacing and chevron alignment are more consistent.
